name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 9 – Am 39
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 9a. Calls, furthermore, for the revision of the registration to the EU Transparency Register of any organisations whose norms and values are in contradiction with EU ones, and for Parliament to adopt more efficient procedures aimed at assessing, where deemed necessary, whether an organisation is conducting democratic interference beyond legitimate interest representation on its premises;
